title: Lane lint checks each handed PR against every other open PR of the same lane, and fails on a conflict
why: Two PRs from one lane can each pass against their own base and still conflict with each other once a batch takes both.
note: Coordinator, 02:23 CST Nov 9. Incident: #1923 and #2112 (lane review-record-provenance) were both released to batch 68 and conflict in 4 files; each was measured only against its own base. Home: `merge --lane-lint`, extending step lane-lint-stack-holds-base's code (git merge-tree against each other open PR of the same lane session). Starts after lane-lint-stack-holds-base.
